rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something that is not real or is only make-believe.

example.english: These are pretend flowers, so you don't need to water them.
example.traditional: 呢啲花係假嘅，唔使淋水。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 faa1 hai6 gaa2 ge3 m4 sai2 lam4 seoi2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for pretending, including acting falsely, make-believe, and feigning a state.

example.english: They always pretend they know everything.
example.traditional: 佢成日扮到自己乜都識咁。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 baan6 dou3 zi6 gei2 mat1 dou1 sik1 gam2

rows.note: Use this when someone is putting on a false act or pretending that something is different from reality.

example.english: You don't need to pretend in front of me.
example.traditional: 你唔使喺我面前扮嘢啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 hai2 ngo5 min6 cin4 baan6 je5 laa1

rows.note: Use this pattern when the make-believe involves pretending to perform an activity, especially in play.

example.jyutping: sai3 lou6 zai2 seng4 jat6 baan6 zyu2 faan6
